_comment: Regression baseline for the Astro Max RL TRAINING half. scripts/ci/check_rl_stats.py compares a fresh training run against this and FAILS if a key stat regresses beyond tolerance. The deploy-side gates (deploy_steps_per_sec, final_tracking_error_m, pose APE) live with the examples evaluation harness in scripts/ci/examples_baselines.json (goto_policy). The 'value' fields were recorded by the first green gpu-rl run on the pinned CI runner (run 30020021108, 2026-07-23, 300 iters).
